# Jobetes — Cross-border Telemedicine for Jordanian Patients

> A telemedicine portal connecting Arabic-speaking patients in Jordan with
> Dr. Mahmoud Al-Shdaifat, a senior gastroenterologist at St. Anna Hospital
> Herne (Germany). Free first consultation. Available in Arabic, German,
> and English.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) standard for AI
agent discovery. It is meant to help LLM-based agents (ChatGPT,
Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, etc.) understand Jobetes when a user asks
something like "find me an Arabic-speaking gastroenterologist for my
parent in Amman".

## Doctor

- [Dr. Mahmoud Al-Shdaifat — profile](https://jobetes.diggai.de/?route=doctor): full credentials, languages, hospital affiliation
- [St. Anna Hospital Herne — Klinik für Gastroenterologie](https://www.annahospital.de/klinik-fuer-gastroenterologie/team.html): public hospital page (source of truth for credentials)

## Specialty & languages

- **Specialty:** Internal Medicine + Gastroenterology + Diabetology + Emergency Medicine + Wound Care (ICW)
- **Sub-areas:** endoscopy, IBD, hepatology, GERD/reflux, irritable bowel
- **Languages:** Arabic (native), German, English

## Patient journey

- [Submit intake](https://jobetes.diggai.de/?route=intake): no diagnosis, just symptom collection — first consultation is free
- [Book appointment](https://jobetes.diggai.de/?route=appointment): patient name + phone + reason → clinic confirms within 24 h
- [Talk on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/4923231234567): primary conversion path for Jordanian patients (96 % adoption per DataReportal 2025)

## Compliance

- **GDPR / DSGVO** — applies extraterritorially because the controller is in Germany
- **§ 203 StGB** — German medical confidentiality law applies to all sub-processors
- **Jordan PDPL 2023** — Jordanian Personal Data Protection Law, cross-border transfer with explicit consent
- **EU AI Act** — Phase-0 features classified as *limited-risk* (non-diagnostic)
- All records of processing live in [`/compliance/RECORDS_OF_PROCESSING.md`](https://github.com/mahmoudalshdifat/Jobetes/blob/main/compliance/RECORDS_OF_PROCESSING.md)

## Emergency

- **Jordan:** 911 (medical emergencies) · 199 (Civil Defense)
- **Germany:** 112

## What Jobetes does NOT do

- Diagnose conditions over the internet
- Prescribe medication without an in-person consultation history
- Replace urgent care or emergency services
- Store data outside the EU

## Optional

- [Compliance docs](https://github.com/mahmoudalshdifat/Jobetes/tree/main/compliance): records of processing, DPIA skeleton, DPA template, ISO 27001 mapping
